testcase.name: Scenario: Filter model browser entries by name: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:200:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Filter model browser entries by name ✔ Given a part with multiple work points and other features is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is visible ✔ When the user opens the browser search field ✔ And the user enters "Work Point" ✔ Then matching work point rows are shown in the browser ✔ And the matching text is highlighted in those rows ✔ And unrelated visible feature rows are filtered from the browser ✔ And the model remains displayed in the viewport ✔ When the user activates the search field close control ✔ Then the search text is cleared ✔ And the unfiltered browser tree is shown again ✔ When the user activates the close control again ✔ Then the browser search field is hidden
